newsitem.title: USA: High River's RJR slate is separate from LeBow's.
newsitem.headline: High River's RJR slate is separate from LeBow's.

text.p: High River Limited Partnership, owned by Carl Icahn, said on Tuesday the slate of nominees submitted by Bennett LeBow for election as directors of RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp was "entirely separate" from the High River slate headed by Tom Rattigan.
Le Bow's slate, comprised of supporters of the breakup of RJR's tobacco and food businesses, came as no surprise to High River.
"It was expected that Mr. LeBow would file a slate of directors today, if only to reserve his right to conduct a proxy contest," High River said.
Bennett LeBow is chairman of the Brooke Group Ltd.
